platform: WPRB 103.3 FM Digital-or-Physical New Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WPRB authorizes new-music submissions to music@wprb.com and prioritizes physical CDs, CD-Rs and vinyl sent to the Music Director. A human must choose the route, verify current attachment versus stream or download-link rules, codecs, metadata, release window, international eligibility and rights requirements, and confirm that the release is suitable. Physical delivery requires current-address confirmation, media selection, postage and customs handling. Do not submit automatically or copy unrelated contacts.

platform: WCBN-FM 88.3 Physical Album Airplay Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WCBN accepts hard-copy albums from musicians, preferably CD or vinyl, sent to WCBN MUSIC at the official station address; genre-specific albums may be marked care of the relevant genre director. A human must confirm that the selected release is an eligible album rather than a single, choose the physical format and genre routing, reconfirm the address, and prepare international postage and customs. The Music Directors email action is Cloudflare-protected and was not decoded; do not use it as a digital-submission workaround without explicit first-party authorization.
